content:
maya: Heads up — I hit some cross-tenant rows in Console Insights while rapidly switching orgs just now. Happens reliably for me when I flip between org 237 -> 451 -> 237 quickly.
liam: can repro on my laptop. saw mixed org ids in the backend request traces. example log: `INFO req=abc123 user=maya org=237 forwarded-org=451 route=/insights/fetch`
jun-sre: ugh. that forwarded-org key looks suspicious. is edge injecting forwarded-org from the prefetch sidecar?
maya: UI prefetch is on. I think the sidecar caches a tenant header per active session tab, not per request.
alejandra: if prefetch caches by session cookie only we could be reusing the wrong org context for background fetches. that would explain the ghost rows.
liam: quick grep in the edge logs shows entries where `X-Org-Id` and `X-Prefetch-Org` differ for the same req_id. snippet:```
2026-02-12T15:03:12Z edge-1 INFO req=abc123 X-Org-Id=237 X-Prefetch-Org=451
```
ben: is this a read-only leakage (UI showing other org rows) or could it touch write paths / quotas?
maya: looks read-only for now but the quota counters were attributed to the wrong org in the metrics graph (saw spike on org-451 while I was on 237). billing team pinged.
jun-sre: immediate mitigation: disable console prefetch for multi-tenant-sensitive routes (insights, exports) and roll that out to canary. I'll open the toggle.
alejandra: long term fix: make the prefetch cache key include canonical tenant id plus tab id + request nonce. also assert tenant consistency in the fetching middleware: if header mismatch emit metric and return 409 to caller for safety.
liam: suggested middleware check (pseudo):
```
if (req.headers['x-prefetch-org'] && req.headers['x-org-id'] !== req.headers['x-prefetch-org']) {
  metric.inc('tenant.mismatch')
  return res.status(409).send('tenant mismatch')
}
```
jun-sre: agree, add a histogram for mismatch rate and an alert if mismatch_rate > 0.1% over 5m. we should also backfill how many mismatches last 24h to estimate customer impact.
ben: for billing impact, will flag finance. we may need to pause billing attribution for affected orgs until we confirm counts.
maya: i've saved a short repro with HAR and a screen grab. putting it in the incident doc.
deploy-bot: canary toggle 'console-prefetch-sensitive' set to OFF in prod-canary at 2026-02-12T15:20Z.
jun-sre: action items: 1) disable prefetch for sensitive routes (done canary) 2) middleware guard + metric PR @liam 3) update cache key @alejandra 4) run backfill audit @ben 5) postmortem and customer outreach @maya. I'll own rollout.
liam: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/edge/pull/4321 with middleware guard, unit tests.
alejandra: i'll PR cache key change after liam lands guard. we can then roll with a phased canary and baseline telemetry.
maya: thanks team — big priority. ping me if you need the HAR or the screen recording. :heart:
ben: thx, I'll coordinate with finance and CS.
jun-sre: logging note — make sure the new guard logs req_id, user, active-tab, and both header values (redacts PII).
liam: ack, adding structured logging.
maya: one more: add an alarm in Console UX telemetry so product folks see any org-mismatch alerts in the dashboard (not just infra).
jun-sre: good call, will spool a dashboard tile.
alle: :thumbsup:
